B0-104
BODY - REAR SEAf
REASSEMBLY
1. INSTALL SEAT CUSHION COVER
Install the seat cushion cover with new hog ring to the seat cushion frame with pad.
HINT:
When installing hog rings, take care to prevent wrinkles as little as possible.
2. INSTALL SEATBACK COVER
(a} Install the seatback cover with new hog ring to the seatback pad.
HINT:
When installing hog rings, take care to prevent wrinkles as little as possible.
{b) Employ the same manner described above to the other side.
3. INSTALL SEATBACK LOCKS
Torque: 21 N-m (210 kgt-cm, 15 ft-lbf)
4. INSTALL SEATBACK FRAME
(a) Install the seatback frame to the seatback cover with pad.
{b) Install new hog rings.
HINT:
When installing hog rings, take care to prevent wrinkles as little as possible.
(c) Install the 5 clips.
(d) Employ the same manner described above to the other side.
5. INSTALL SEATBACK LOCK KNOB HOLDERS
6. INSTALL SEATBACK LOCK KNOB
